title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop by creating a rectangle with the following lines: the first line starts at [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.0652, 0.0]; the second line starts at [0.0652, 0.0] and ends at [0.0652, 0.0326]; the third line starts at [0.0652, 0.0326] and ends at [0.0, 0.0326]; the fourth line starts at [0.0, 0.0326] and ends at [0.0, 0.0]. Within the same face, draw the second loop by creating a circle centered at [0.0163, 0.0163] with a radius of 0.0041. Draw the third loop by creating another circle centered at [0.0489, 0.0163] with the same radius of 0.0041. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0652 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] degrees and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body. The part dimensions are as follows: length is 0.06521739130434782 units, width is 0.03260869565217391 units, and height is 0.75 units.

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
Lx = 0.0652   # X
Ly = 0.0326   # Y
Lz = 0.7500   # Z

# Base bar
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(Lx, Ly, Lz, centered=(True, True, False))

# Two holes near the top of the bar, drilled through the thin Y direction
hole_d = 0.008
spacing = 0.033

r = (
    r.faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .center(0, 0)
    .pushPoints([(-spacing / 2, 0), (spacing / 2, 0)])
    .hole(hole_d)
)

r = r.translate((Lx / 2, Ly / 2, 0))
